task_description: Upgrade Profile & Account Management into an enterprise-grade module with 2FA, active sessions, login activity, online presence, notification preferences, theme preferences, connected cloud accounts, security activity timeline, data export, account deletion, and a modern tabbed UI similar to GitHub Settings / AWS Console.

verification.summary: Build and tests cannot be run due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode (npm registry blocked). All changes verified via manual code review and semantic review. Critical issues found in v1 review (session identity mismatch, backup code security, presence throttle) were fixed in a follow-up commit.

fixes_applied: Removed broken session exclusion logic in revokeAllOtherSessions (access token vs refresh token mismatch)
Changed GET /2fa/backup-codes to POST with password verification
Fixed audit log to capture original email before deletion anonymization
Removed notify from useEffect dependency arrays to prevent infinite re-fetch
